features.name: Patterson Park Observatory
features.description: The 1891-92 Observatory, widely called the Pagoda, is Patterson Park's signature hilltop landmark and viewpoint, but its interior is currently closed for maintenance indefinitely.

details.positionQuality: Preserved coordinate for Patterson Park Observatory
details.imageAlt: Patterson Park Observatory at Patterson Park

features.name: Boat Lake
features.description: Boat Lake is Patterson Park's restored wetland and open-water habitat, now used for fishing, wildlife viewing, and education rather than public boating or swimming.

details.coordinateSource: AuditMap reviewed placement from park and visitor maps

features.name: Marble Fountain
features.description: The restored 1865 Marble Fountain is a small gathering landmark near the Lombard Street and Patterson Park Avenue side of the park.

details.coordinateSource: Wikimedia Commons image camera coordinates cross-checked with Friends of Patterson Park
details.imageAuthor: Baltimore Heritage from Baltimore, MD, USA

features.name: War of 1812 Memorial Cannons
features.description: The memorial cannons sit beside the Observatory area and recall Patterson Park's role at Hampstead Hill during the defense of Baltimore.

features.name: Virginia S. Baker Recreation Center
features.description: Virginia S. Baker Recreation Center is Patterson Park's year-round indoor program hub, with a gym, multipurpose and meeting rooms, game room, kitchen, and computer lab.
